DESIGN PROTOTYPE
Implementation status · edition 09

Four CockroachDB stores and a local HTTP gateway form the container lab. Regional production gateways, HA, CDC/Kafka and distributed resource isolation are target designs. Check the implementation matrix before engineering from this page.

Legal entity federation / Design edition 04

Permission meets physical reality.

OPA evaluates the recipient legal entity and the actual resolved storage country together.

Operational isolation decision · edition 07

Policy guard, operational delivery and bulk reconciliation have separate resource budgets. Policy activation performs bounded authority work; broad data movement runs independently. Read the revised contract · Run the isolation model. The v3 runtime remains a thin serial harness.

Operational model extension · v3

The working example now separates global party minimums from relationship graphs, with table defaults and major-key restrictions. Business model · Parallel controls · Service transactions. Earlier flat-record examples below remain illustrative; they do not define the normalized relationship key.

Required intersection

ConditionWhat must hold
RecipientNamed legal entity is permitted, not explicitly excluded, and accepts inbound sharing.
EntitlementActive, unexpired servicing grant with an approved field profile.
BindingThe resolved store matches the versioned entity directory.
Entity placementPhysical store country is approved for the destination entity.
Customer geographyPhysical country is allowed and not explicitly excluded for this owner relationship.
AuthoritySingle owner writer; no implicit authority inherited through another entity.

Input shape

JSON · design skeleton
{
  "customer": {
    "owner_entity_id": "LE-SG-01",
    "allowed_entities": ["LE-GB-02", "LE-CA-01"],
    "denied_entities": [],
    "allowed_countries": ["SG", "GB", "US"],
    "denied_countries": ["US"],
    "purpose": "servicing",
    "grants": {"LE-CA-01": {"active": true, "expires_at": 4102444800,
      "purpose": "servicing", "profile": "minimal"}}
  },
  "destination_entity": {"id": "LE-CA-01", "store_id": "STORE-US-01",
    "approved_countries": ["US"], "accepts_inbound": true, "placement_version": 1},
  "destination_store": {"id": "STORE-US-01", "country": "US"},
  "now": 1791660000
}
Expected decision: deny

The Canadian recipient is on the allowlist and has an active entitlement, but its resolved US store is explicitly excluded. Incorporation country does not override physical placement.

Enforcement and provenance

The trusted harness supplies directory attributes; callers cannot choose a different country value through the API. Production needs signed/versioned bundles, authoritative facts, scoped permits and destination-side verification. OPA decides; the service enforces, persists fences and transacts. Missing output or OPA transport errors fail closed.

Field profiles

ProfileApproved fields
minimalname, tier
contactname, tier, email
Always owner-onlynotes; no profile exports confidential notes.

Executable source

The v2 download includes actual Rego, twelve OPA tests and an entity-aware harness. The browser simulation has been compared with real OPA across 990 scenario/recipient decisions.

Read the full prompt
Operational isolation decision: use three regional work classes: authority guard, operational delivery and bulk reconciliation. Separate relay paths, queues/topics, worker groups, connection/concurrency budgets and retry/quarantine paths. A policy transaction advances scoped authority and creates a guard intent plus one reconciliation cursor; it must not enumerate affected rows. Operational commits remain local ACID with outbox/audit/idempotency. Operational priority never bypasses current policy. Source restriction commit, remote enforcement and physical convergence are separate milestones. Read the Work isolation page before implementing any queue or policy change. The interactive lab and admission specification are synthetic; the v3 database harness still has its original process lock and serial worker.

Extend the v3 operational PoC, preserving 30 legal entities and three independent single-node store models. Business data is normalized across 12 tables; sovereignty policies live in parallel control tables. A separate party scope exports only id/global_party_id/party_type; relationship scopes export connected whitelisted graphs. Global distribution still needs grants and approved geography; deny overrides. Do not infer relationship access from a global party, common store or shared identity. Keep the single local transaction and asynchronous destination acknowledgement distinct. The hosted UI is a labelled browser simulation. Real OPA tests have run, but CockroachDB integration and browser visual QA are unverified here. Use synthetic data only. Deliver bounded adapters, actual migrations, meaningful invariant tests and honest run results.

Apply the normalized operational extension before the earlier component requirements below.

Design edition 04: 30 synthetic bank legal entities (UK 3, Asia 8, Americas 3, MENAT 5, rest of Europe 11), mapped independently to three physical PoC stores in Singapore, London and New York. Asia assumes one entity in each of eight countries. All names, mappings and country rules are illustrative, not legal advice or bank policy. Preserve global customer identity; master key is (owner_entity_id, global_customer_id); projection key additionally includes destination_entity_id. Sharing a store or global ID does not share entitlements. OPA evaluates entity grants AND resolved physical country restrictions, with deny override. The downloadable implementation is a single Python/FastAPI harness, three independent CockroachDB single nodes, three OPA engines, outbox polling and OpenTelemetry. The hosted monitor is a labelled browser simulation. Local HA, Java regional services, CDC/Kafka, distributed fencing and signed permits are production extension work. The original v3 catalog planner does not execute migrations. Edition 08 adds an isolated executable relocation slice and optional fourth store; see Entity relocation. Automatic geography failover remains prohibited.

Extend policies/federation.rego while preserving deny precedence and default-deny behaviour. Validate destination store binding, entity placement, customer geography, active entitlement, purpose and field profile. Add malformed-input and signature/permit tests before exposing remote admission. Keep OPA decision logs redacted and regional.
